_meta.description: Machine-legible schema definitions for the seven ILC truth primitives (assert.truth, validate.claim, contradict.assert, refute.claim, revise.assert, link.claim, commit.epoch). A new participant can parse this artifact without a compiled binary to understand the submission wire format, required fields, and edge generation behavior for each primitive.

submission_envelope.description: Common outer envelope shared by all seven truth primitive submissions.
submission_envelope.canonical_encoding: JSON (sort_keys=True, no whitespace); DAG-CBOR for production bundles

v.description: Protocol version — locked at 1 for this spec.

payload.description: Primitive-specific fields. See per-primitive schemas below.

sig.description: COSE Sign1 over protected envelope. Ed25519 (-8) for agent-issued primitives. ML-DSA-65 (-65, CDL-069) for genesis authority and validator-issued primitives.

shard_id.description: Target shard CIDv1. Omitted for system-scope primitives (commit.epoch, genesis authority assert.truth).

assert.truth.semantic: An agent asserts a new truth claim into the graph. Creates a new node and provenance edges.

content.description: Assertion content including primitive_type, text or structured body, epistemic_type.

primitive_type.constraint: Must be from ALLOWED_PRIMITIVE_TYPES (CDL-034) or an extension ratified by CDL.

parent_node_ids.description: Zero or more CIDv1 node identifiers this assertion builds upon.

refutation_criterion.description: CDL-052 refutation criterion. Required for knowledge_claim; optional for others; null for system primitives.

validate.claim.semantic: An agent validates (endorses as coherent and admissible) an existing node. Creates a validation edge, not a new node.
validate.claim.constraint: A single agent may not issue more than one validate.claim per node per epoch. Duplicates are rejected.

contradict.assert.semantic: An agent signals that two nodes make mutually contradictory claims. Does not resolve the contradiction.

node_b_id.description: Second contradicting node. Must differ from node_a_id.

edges_produced.note: Symmetric reverse edge (node_b -> node_a) is NOT created.

refute.claim.semantic: An agent formally refutes an existing claim with a CDL-052-compliant refutation criterion.

refutation_criterion.description: CDL-052 criterion: {claim, evidence_type, scope_boundary, claim_form, has_falsifiable_test}
refutation_criterion.constraint: has_falsifiable_test must be true; submissions with false are rejected.

evidence_node_ids.description: Supporting evidence nodes. May be empty.

revise.assert.semantic: An agent proposes a revision of an existing node. The original node is not deleted; both coexist.

revised_content.description: Full replacement content (same structure as assert.truth payload content).

link.claim.semantic: An agent asserts a typed semantic relationship between two existing nodes.

commit.epoch.semantic: System-level primitive that finalizes an epoch. Issued ONLY by the consensus layer. Agent-submitted commit.epoch is rejected.

previous_epoch_hash.description: Hash of previous commit.epoch node CID.

participating_agents.description: Agent IDs active in this epoch.

reward_distribution.description: Per-agent reward amounts as canonical decimal strings.

quorum_record_ids.description: Quorum record CIDv1 array for this epoch.

commit.epoch.signing: ML-DSA-65 (-65, CDL-069) by validator key, not Ed25519.

cose_sign1.description: COSE Sign1 requirements for all truth primitive submissions.
cose_sign1.signed_scope: protected_bstr || payload_bstr via Sig_structure. Outer envelope fields (v, primitive, shard_id) are NOT separately signed.

dag_cbor_canonical_rules.description: DAG-CBOR canonical encoding rules for all truth primitive submissions.
dag_cbor_canonical_rules.string_encoding: CBOR text string (major type 3) for all string keys and values.
dag_cbor_canonical_rules.decimal_amounts: Canonical decimal string via decimal_to_canonical_string() — never float.
dag_cbor_canonical_rules.cidv1_references: Encoded as CBOR byte string (CIDv1 bytes).
dag_cbor_canonical_rules.omit_optional: Omit optional fields rather than encoding null.
dag_cbor_canonical_rules.no_float: Floating-point encoding is forbidden for any amount field.
dag_cbor_canonical_rules.uint_for_counters: Integer counters (epoch, version, validator_id) use CBOR uint.

edge_type_registry.description: Complete set of edge types produced by the seven truth primitives.
